# ed25519 signing key for busbar-signed virtual keys (64 hex chars, printed above on stdout).
# auth.signing_key is a secret REFERENCE, not an inline value - wire the key like so:
#
#   # write it to a file, then reference the file:
#   busbar --generate-signing-key > /run/secrets/busbar-signing.key
#   auth:
#     signing_key: { file: /run/secrets/busbar-signing.key }
#
#   # or export it and reference the env var (fleet: SAME value on every node).
#   # paste the 64-hex key printed above on stdout (NOT shown here, so this guidance stays
#   # secret-free and safe to capture in a journal/CI log):
#   export BUSBAR_SIGNING_KEY=<paste-the-64-hex-key-printed-above>
#   auth:
#     signing_key: { env: BUSBAR_SIGNING_KEY }
#
# Fleet-shared so every node verifies the same tokens; rotating it REVOKES every outstanding virtual key.
